declaredAdvisories.reason: The published MCP tool schema listed run_composer_queries, but the MCP server never registered that tool, so tools/list never offered it and every call to it failed. The composer query tool now ships on MCP under its in-app name, query. MCP clients see no change in behaviour: the old name never worked and the new name is new.

impact.firstPartyOnly: No client could ever call run_composer_queries because the MCP server never registered it; it existed only in the generated schema file.
